prose: The brilliant archeoastronomy analyst John McHugh returns to InnerVerse to share his field work and research on the ancient cultures of the American Southwest. In this video presentation John presents a comprehensive catalogue of petroglyphs and rock art through the ages and a crash course in the academic understanding of their cultural chronology. Dancing with live snakes? Check. Symbolic signatures of the universal monomyth and its archetypes? Got that too! Tune in for a shamanic synthesis of John's many years of investigation.
ext: We continue John's presentation, with artifacts and evidence of thunder rattles, face scalping, decapitated maize gods, kachina spirits, and a summary roundup of what all these strange and fascinating relics might mean about human nature and our deep past.
